verdict.rationale: Marketing copy describes a natural-language feature where a user can 'describe the audience, journey, or growth goal' and mParticle 'understands the data... suggests the logic... helps turn intent into activation,' which is a narrow AI-assisted capability scoped to audience/journey building rather than a general-purpose built-in assistant for delegating tasks across the product. Missing for 10: named assistant product, broader task-delegation scope beyond audience building, technical documentation of how it works, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
